code_only_features.feature_name: give_up sentinel lets subject stop the rollout
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:395 gave_up = give_up_sentinel in (resp.text or ''); harness.py:398 stop_reason = 'give_up'; harness.py:427-428 'if gave_up: break' actually terminates the turn loop. The sentinel is offered to the subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:33-34: '...you may output the single token {give_up} on its own line to stop.'). It is wired end-to-end: detected, recorded, and honored as a loop break.
code_only_features.justification_quote: If you conclude you genuinely cannot make progress, you may output the single token {give_up} on its own line to stop. -- framed around progress/give-up signal for analysis (DESIGN: 'recording why a rollout ended is necessary for the analysis'); no welfare language in the code.
